cause: CSS fill-box transform-origin:center rotated each hand around its own midpoint; separately translated clock layers also drifted apart during their entrances.
correction: Stationary SVG face and marks, both hand paths start at (480,267), and both SVG rotate transforms use that same center. Minute hand advances from 90 to 120 degrees; hour hand from 7.5 to 10 degrees. Gold arc draws from 15 to 20 minutes with matching progress.
